The real reason they come back

The Scent Trail Cycle

Mice barely use their eyes to get around your home. They follow their noses.

Every mouse that gets in leaves a trail of pheromones and urine behind it, an invisible highway from the gap under your door to the food in your pantry. Every new mouse picks up that trail and follows it straight in.

When a trap catches one mouse, the highway stays open. The next one arrives, follows the same trail, and the cycle starts over. That's why "it worked for a week" is the most common story with traps.

To stop mice for good, break the trail at the entry points. Catching whichever mouse walks down it won't do it.

The fix

That's why we built the 4-Oil Barrier

Peppermint oil · 40%Overwhelms a mouse's sense of smell on contact, so it can't read the trail and backs away.
Cinnamon oil · 5%Masks the pheromone trails, so new mice can't find the path in.
Cedarwood oil · 4%Makes the area unattractive for nesting.
Castor-oil base · 5%Releases the blend slowly, so one pouch keeps working for up to 90 days.

Each pouch creates a barrier of roughly 65 sq. ft. Place one at every entry point and the highway is closed.

Questions, answered

How long does it take to work?

Most customers notice less activity within 72 hours. By week two the entry points are covered and the old trails are masked. Results vary with how severe the infestation is and how many entry points you have.

What if it doesn't work?

If mice haven't left within 30 days, email support@getridof.shop and we'll refund your purchase in full. No forms, no hassle.

Is it OK around my dog, kids or livestock?

There's no poison and no rodenticide in it. The formula is four plant oils: peppermint, cinnamon, cedarwood and castor. As with any household product, place pouches where children and pets can't chew on them.

How many do I need and where do I put them?

A single room, RV or garage needs 1 pack. A full home needs 3 packs. A large home with a shed or barn needs 5. Place a pouch every 8–10 feet along entry points: doors, under sinks, behind appliances, basement corners.

How is this different from peppermint spray?

Concentration and delivery. Store-bought sprays are usually under 1% peppermint oil and fade within hours. Our pouches hold a 40% peppermint blend in a castor-oil base that releases slowly for up to 90 days.

How long does one pouch last?

Up to 90 days. Replace pouches every 90 days for continuous protection.

Do I need to do anything or just place it?

Just place it. No setup, no baiting, no checking, no resetting.

When will my order ship?

Usually within 1 business day. US delivery typically takes 5–12 business days.

Do I have to subscribe?

No. Subscribe & save is ticked by default because it's the lowest price; untick it for a one-time purchase. If you subscribe, you can skip or cancel anytime from your account or by emailing support@getridof.shop. There's no minimum and no fee.
